mostWorthwhile.text: Checking the address against the handset was most worthwhile: it clarified that the directory, not a spelling error, caused the rejection.

leastWorthwhile.text: Powering the bell felt less engaging because it was the only offered action and its connection to the delivery was unclear at first.

surprise.text: The handset read the address correctly but still refused it because it was absent from the active service directory.

arbitrary.text: Combining the unloaded trolley with the handset felt arbitrary beforehand; its purpose only became clear when Eli signed the receipt.

continue.text: Yes. The conflicting receipt and rejection make me curious how the neighbors might address the underlying directory problem, although the mostly forced final actions were less engaging.
